'''Alamar''' was a young [[Ghostling]] child was captured, along with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Arawynne]], by [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]] and brought to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to be sold as a slave. Alamar was just five and a half at the time.
